verdict.rationale: Whisper is offered through a hosted API, so asking for a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence shows no such spec: every OpenAPI and Swagger path probed returned 404. The llms.txt documentation index and the markdown guides are documentation, not an OpenAPI-equivalent spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
